files.purpose: The whole left sidebar of the Droppy Code thread window in one file: search field plus activity toggle, the scrolling thread list in two layouts (project layout grouped by Project, activity layout grouped by Needs attention / Pinned / Today / Yesterday / weekday / date), helper sub-rows joined by a dotted connector, Hydra head glyph cards, folded-helper stub lines, the Settled section with its collapsible header, live drag-to-reorder of thread rows with haptics, rename/delete/archive popovers, per-row ellipsis popovers and AppKit context menus, the bottom Add project and Settings rows, plus the caches (SidebarItemCache, PlacementCache, RowHeights, RowFrames, FrameHolder) and the shared MinuteClock that keeps relative times fresh.

feature_notes: Both layouts share one list, so a thread keeps its row when the layout changes and the row grows, shrinks and slides instead of being replaced; a settled thread however takes a different item id ("settled-<uuid>" vs the plain uuid string), so its open row leaves and a settled row arrives, and a reopen's ghost glides between the two

The sidebar doubles as a popover from the chat's Threads button (inPopover = true): no traffic-light clearance, no WindowDragArea, top padding 12 instead of 14, listFrame passed as nil so no glide can cross windows, and picking a thread calls dismiss()

The delete flow is deliberately ordered: the popover binding compares UUIDs only, confirmDeletion stores a ConfirmedDeletion and clears pendingDeletionID and pendingArchiveID, and carryOutConfirmedDeletion runs the delete in a Task only after the popover content's onDisappear; the comment records that the earlier ordering crashed in the presentation binding's getter after the row (and, in the Threads popover, the whole list) had been torn down
confirmBeforeDeleting == false deletes straight from the menu with no popover at all

Reorder: 4 pt of movement grabs the row under the pointer at the grab (settled and helper rows report no frame, so a drag from one goes nowhere); the grabbed row lifts with .scaleEffect(1.02), a Chrome.overlay(0.12) fill and .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.28), radius: 10, y: 4) on spring(response: 0.25, dampingFraction: 0.8); its own follow uses a Transaction with disablesAnimations = true; neighbours slide on spring(response: 0.28, dampingFraction: 0.82); each swap fires .alignment haptics and re-takes DragPeers; release animates back on spring(response: 0.32, dampingFraction: 0.8). Fallback slot height for the crossing math is Chrome.rowHeight + 1

Slot height per peer = its measured row height + 1, plus, when unfolded, every non-head helper's height + 1 (default 24), plus, when heads show, one head-card height + 1 sized for (headCount + 5) / 6 rows; a folded parent adds the stub row's height + 1 instead
Helpers, the head card and the folded stub ride with a dragged parent through RidesWithDraggedParent (same offset, same zIndex 1), so a thread and everything under it travel as one block
Reordering is disabled while the search field has text

Scroll freeze: any scroll phase change or contentOffset.y change sets isListScrolling, which turns .allowsHitTesting off for the whole list so rows take no hover and no clicks; a 150 ms debounce task clears it, and an .idle phase cancels the task and clears it immediately; the flag is only written when it is false, to avoid one body pass per frame

Project layout order per project: pinned open threads, then the other open threads, then a 4 pt gap, then the Settled header, then the settled threads; settledCollapsed breaks out of the loop so nothing under the header is built at all. Projects are separated by a Chrome.groupGap spacer item and a folded project shows a count of its threads plus their helpers

Activity layout order: "Needs attention" (threads with approvals or questions, never settled) first, then "Pinned" open threads, then day groups of the rest by updatedAt, then the settled section sorted by AppModel.settledFirst; a helper whose parent is not shown stands on its own as a top-level row
needsAttention(thread) is true when model.existingRuntime(for:) has any approvals or any questions

placed(): newest updatedAt first, except threads with an activityOrder whose activityOrderDay is the same calendar day as updatedAt, which keep their dragged place in ascending order; a thread that became active after a reorder has no place and sorts to the top
Day titles: "Today", "Yesterday", the wide weekday name when fewer than 7 days old, month+day within the same year, otherwise month+day+year
orderedHeads: running heads first, newest createdAt first within each of running and finished
hydraAutoHidesIdleHeads hides the whole head card when no head is running; both the flag and the set of parents that still draw a card are part of the list cache key
The folded stub calls the group "heads" only when every folded thread is a Hydra head; any mix says "helpers"

Search matches a lowercased query against a per-thread lowercased title table (only changed titles are lowercased again), or against the project name, which then returns all of that project's threads and their helpers; each result carries the project's full thread count for its header row, and project rows in search results pass togglesExpansion: false

Row transitions: a settled thread's row, the Settled header and gap items use plain .opacity; every other row uses .sidebarRow, an asymmetric transition of insertion .opacity with .easeIn(duration: 0.18).delay(0.12) and removal .opacity with .easeOut(duration: 0.06)

A settle pops the check on spring(response: 0.3, dampingFraction: 0.45) and changes the model in the same pass under Chrome.panelSlide, so the row leaves on the removal fade rather than flying; only a reopen launches a glide, and the comment says the settle branches inside glide(_:) are kept for the flight's shape but no longer run

A reopen's glide renders a departure face at the row's window frame (trailingClearance computed with showsActions: true) and an arrival face at the destination height (24 settled, 48 when a project name shows, else Chrome.rowHeight) with showsActions: false; when the destination is out of view the fallback rect sits at the list's maxY for a settle and at minY - arrivalHeight for a reopen

Row frames are only reported to RowGlideAnimator while the row is dragged, hovered, or a glide is in the air, so scrolling costs nothing; the arriving row calls RowGlideAnimator.shared.land(threadID:settled:at:) to tell the ghost where to touch down

A row hidden by a glide goes to opacity 0 with no animation and comes back with .easeOut(duration: 0.12), matching the animator's 0.12 s handover window; helper rows, head cards and stubs read RowGlideAnimator.shared.isHiding(parent) and vanish with their parent
Archive from the hover button flies a GenieAnimator ghost of the row's face (trailingClearance 52) over a Chrome.overlay(0.12 when selected else 0.06) fill, then archives under Chrome.panelSlide
model.sidebarRevealThreadID scrolls the named thread's row to .center under Chrome.panelSlide and then clears the request, so a thread moved to another project shows where it landed

model.archiveRequest (the keyboard shortcut) opens the archive question on that thread's own row; the popover installs a local keyDown monitor that answers key codes 36 and 76 with archive and 53 with dismiss, but only when event.window is a ThreadWindow and no modifier outside KeyChord.allowedModifiers is held, so Return never falls through to the composer

model.finishRequest (menu, shortcut or palette) is only taken up by the row whose id matches and whose isSettled equals request.reopens; the row clears it and runs its own settle() or reopen(), so it looks exactly like clicking the check
The list animates on model.threads.count, model.projects.map(\.isExpanded) and model.settings.settledCollapsed, all with Chrome.panelSlide
mergeStage(of:) returns (runtime.hydraMergeStage ?? "Merging") + "\u2026" while a Hydra merge runs; that text replaces the project name in the row's second line and becomes the spinner's tooltip
trailingClearance: showing actions gives 30 when settled and 52 when open, plus 20 more when the fold button shows; otherwise 18 for a detailed or settled row and 52 for a plain one

Equatable rows skip re-evaluation on value inputs only: SidebarThreadRow compares id, title, updatedAt, isPinned, isSettled, projectName, isDragged and whether onToggleFold is nil; SidebarHelperRow compares id, title, updatedAt, isPinned, isSettled and isLast; closures, the menu box and frame holders are deliberately excluded, and live state still reaches the body through the model's per-thread cells

Caches: PlacementCache rebuilds the ThreadPlacement array only when its 18-field Fingerprint array changes; SidebarItemCache keys the built list on placements, projects, the attention id set, activityView, activityThreadStyle, settledCollapsed, autoHidesIdleHeads and parentsShowingHeads, keys the helper grouping on the placements alone, and keys search on threads, projects and query
MinuteClock.shared ticks every 60 seconds so relative times stay truthful in an idle app; only RelativeTimeLabel observes it, so the tick re-renders those labels alone
Helper grouping counts a thread as a helper when it is not archived and either not in a panel or is a Hydra head, grouped by parentThreadID and sorted newest createdAt first
helperItems returns nothing for a settled thread, so what a thread spawned comes back only when it reopens
A project's folded count is its threads plus the helpers under them, computed once per list build rather than per row
unresolved_questions: Chrome's literal values (trafficLightDiameter, trafficLightTop, listInset, groupGap, rowHeight, rowCornerRadius, rowHorizontalPadding, iconSize, iconFont, inlineIconFont, panelSlide, hover and every color token) are referenced but defined in another file, so the exact numbers, curves and colors are not establishable from here
RowDrag.settle(order:heights:fallbackHeight:) performs the centre-crossing math; this file only supplies the inputs and the swap closure, so the exact crossing rule lives in RowDrag's own file
RowGlideAnimator's 0.12 s handover window, its render/launch mechanics, and GenieAnimator.coordinateSpace's string value are described in comments here but implemented elsewhere
ActivityThreadStyle has at least a .icon case used here; its other cases are declared in another file
AppModel.settledFirst's ordering rule (described only as latest settled first) is defined in AppModel, not here

In SidebarHelperRow the comment "The ellipsis popover's items. Kept on the instance: a popover is not an AppKit menu." sits immediately above the Equatable == implementation rather than above makeActions(); it reads as a misplaced comment with no behavioral effect, but the intent is not stated
ProjectRow.togglesExpansion defaults to true and is passed false only from the search list, making a project row inert there; whether it is meant to still look clickable is not stated in the file
